description: Two fighting ranges in one spec - Shadow bolts from range to bank Rage, a lifestealing bruiser in Accursed Form to spend it, and no respec between them.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_bloodmage__accursed.txt: 'Closest to a Feral/Guardian Druid's form-dancing bolted onto a Blood DK self-sustain layer ... No retail spec fuses ranged caster and melee lifesteal natively.' Its stat priority - Hit > Expertise > Agility > Armor Penetration > Crit > Haste - is a melee list on a spec that spends half the fight casting, which is why Rage converts attack power into spell power and Forbidden Power converts Agility into spell crit. The awkward part of the translation is that CoA strips the Rage cost off every transformed ability, and the engine has no way to make a cost conditional on a buff; Reave, Ravenous Strike and Puncturing Fangs all pay full price, and Night Hunter is the tree's apology for it.

nodes.name: Rage
nodes.description: Grants spell power equal to 2% of your attack power, and increases the damage of Reave by 3%, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell damage by 15% of your attack power and the damage dealt by Reave by 10%.' The node that makes a spec with a melee stat priority still hit hard with its bolts.

nodes.name: Barely Human
nodes.description: Increases your armor penetration by 1% and the damage of Veinburst by 3%, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your armor penetration and the damage of spells that cost health by 15%.' Veinburst is this spec's main health-cost spell. armor_penetration_pct is percentage POINTS - it is one of the ten keys _recalculate_derived_stats divides by 100.

nodes.name: Forbidden Power
nodes.description: Grants spell critical strike chance equal to 4% of your Agility per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell critical strike rating by 30% of your Agility and spell hit rating by 5% of your Agility.' The crit half is a real conversion; hit rating is a local feeding base_miss_chance_*, not a Character attribute, so it cannot be a conversion target - the same wall Guardian's Bulwark hit.

nodes.name: Killer Instinct
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each point of Rage now increases the critical strike chance of Veinburst and Reave by 0.5%.' Rage is not a scaling source anything reads, so it is flat crit. CoA's stat priority names this node: 'Critical Strike (Killer Instinct/Ultra Instinct/Darkcasting are all crit-fed)'.

nodes.name: Dark Hunt
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Shadow damage dealt by 10% against bleeding targets.' Nothing tracks whether a target is bleeding at damage time, so the condition is dropped and the size cut to match.

nodes.name: Crimson Expedition
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Bloodbolt and Aortic Assault by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Bloodbolt, Blood Shards, and Aortic Assault by 10%.' Blood Shards are a charge mechanic with no hook.

nodes.name: One Man's Curse...
nodes.description: Reduces the health cost of Accursed Form by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Removes the health cost of Accursed Form and entering it now instantly restores 15% of your maximum health.' A cost reduction is expressible; the heal on entry is not.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.description: Increases your hit rating by 1 and your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA ships Relentless as a free level-40 passive, which Frontier has no equivalent of. Pointed at the spec's own stat priority, which leads with Hit and Expertise because 'direct-hit strikes like Reave/Ravenous Strike/Puncturing Fangs must land'.

nodes.name: Gore Barrage
nodes.description: Reduces the health cost of Veinburst and Hemoburst by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cost of spells that cost health and Animated Blood by -30%.' Animated Blood is a summon with no pet template, so only the health-cost half is here.

nodes.name: Unchained
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your damaging Mortal Form spells can now be cast while moving.' There is no cast time and no movement in combat here, so the free level-10 passive becomes the nearest real benefit: acting more often.

nodes.name: Blood Shards
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 20% chance per rank to carry an extra 15% damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Shadow Damage dealt now generates 1 Blood Shard ... up to 8. Dealing damage with Veinburst will now expend all stacks of Blood Shards.' A banked-charge spender has no hook, so it becomes a chance-based bonus on the same hit - which is what bonus_pct is for.

nodes.name: Cruel Intent
nodes.description: Lunge and Crimson Maw have a 10% chance per rank to be followed by an extra weapon strike.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you Lunge at an enemy you now strike them 3 times with auto attacks.' extra_attack re-invokes the caster's own bloodmage_attack for a real second swing with its own hit and crit rolls, once - not three times, since the payload is a flag.

nodes.name: Everlasting Hunt
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Veinburst and Reave by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Blood Shards now reduces the cooldown of Veinburst and Reave by -1.5 sec.' A cooldown that always has at least one turn left (see talented_cooldown's floor), so this cannot make either spammable.

nodes.name: Fang Over Fang
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reave by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Bloodfang Bite now has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Reave.' A cooldown reset has no proc shape, so the node buys the same thing the reset would have: more Reave damage per fight.

nodes.name: Dark Sigil
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance with weapons and spells by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3% ... In addition, you now heal for 15% of all critical damage dealt.' The party half cannot be a talent effect; the crit half covers both of this spec's damage types, which is the point of it.

nodes.name: Sanguine Scripture
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Upon exiting Accursed Form, you gain 70% movement speed and spell haste for 5 seconds.' Movement speed has no combat meaning here and the form has no exit event to hang a buff on.

nodes.name: Battleweaver
nodes.description: Increases your physical and spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Cursed Form abilities now has a 50% chance to generate 1 Blood Shard ... Dealing damage with Bloodbolt will launch 1 Blood Shard.' The one node in the tree that pays off both halves of the spec at once, which is what it does in CoA too.

nodes.name: Crimson Feast
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Bloodsurge by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Every 5 second you remain in a Cursed Form now reduces the cooldown of your Bloodsurge by -5 sec.' The curses here are untimed buffs, so the reduction is unconditional and smaller.

nodes.name: Terrorizer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Puncturing Fangs by 6% and Veinburst by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Veinburst, Bloodfang Bite, and Claw Sweep on enemies below 35% health by 25%.' Bloodfang Bite and Claw Sweep belong to Eternal, so the node points at this spec's own melee button instead, and the health gate is dropped.

nodes.name: Night Hunter
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage and health cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Veinburst now has a 40% chance to not trigger a cooldown ... Your Bloodbolt now has a 40% chance to refund half of its Rage cost.' A refund chance has no hook; a flat discount is the same thing averaged out. POSITIVE is the discount - talented_cost does cost * (1 - pct), and Guardian, Barbarian and Felsworn all ship this key negative, i.e. as a surcharge their tooltips do not mention.

nodes.name: Blood Scent
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 20% chance per rank to drain 12% of the damage dealt back into you.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Dealing direct damage to enemies below 35% maximum health now leeches health equal to 10% of the damage dealt.' The execute window is not visible to a proc, so it leeches all the time at a lower chance - and this spec needs it, since 'Every point of sustain is damage-gated'.

nodes.name: Darkcasting
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike damage by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA lists Darkcasting with Killer Instinct and Ultra Instinct as the spec's crit payoffs.

nodes.name: Ultra Instinct
nodes.description: You stop deciding and start landing. Increases your critical strike chance by 3% and your critical strike damage by 10%, with weapons and with spells.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Direct ability critical strikes now increase your spell and ability critical strike chance and critical damage by 3% for 10 sec. Each additional critical strike increases this by an additional 3%, but reduces its duration by -1 sec.' A self-shortening stack has no hook, so the first stack is made permanent.
